entities.summary: Igreja de Santa Maria de Airães is a church in Portugal. The current building was constructed during the late 13th or early 14th century AD; however, the site has held a church since at least the 11th century AD. It has been classified as a National Monument since 1977. Airães was a freguesia of Portugal in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
